highlights: ` 1 | P a g e ( 4 t h N o v 2 0 2 6 ) For any further query, please email us on research@venturasecurities.com CleanMax Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd Q2FY27 Result Update 2 | P a g e ( 4 t h N o v 2 0 2 6 ) For any further query, please email us on research@venturasecurities.com Key Consolidated Financials (INR cr): Source: Ventura Research Net Revenue EBITDA Adj.
Consolidated revenue from operations increased 37% YoY to INR 728 Cr, while reported EBITDA grew 51% YoY to INR 548 Cr, translating into an EBITDA margin of 75.3%.
Adjusted EBITDA increased 43% YoY to INR 553 Cr, while consolidated PAT rose 82% YoY to INR 65 Cr.
For H1FY27, revenue grew 67% YoY to INR 1,560 Cr, adjusted EBITDA increased 56% YoY to INR 1,047 Cr and PAT rose over sixfold to INR 120 Cr.
valuation: Valuation call – We initiate coverage on CleanMax with a BUY rating.
We recommend BUY at the CMP of INR 1,249 with a price target of INR 1,641 (8X FY29 EV/EBITDA), representing an upside of 31%.
